text: XXXX XXXX XXXX, XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX, XXXX XXXX XXXX Unknown Account Number Credit Management LP. , credit is falsely reporting on my credit I have never had an account with them. They are falsely reporting this account to my credit file against my rights and fair credit act. under 15 US section code 1681D-disclosure of investigative consumer reports. I have attached the definition so you can see the violation! ( a ) disclosure of fact of preparation. A. A person may not procure or cause to be prepared an investigative consumer report on any consumer unless ( 1 ) it is clearly and accurately disclosed to the consumer that an investigative consumer report including information as to his character, general reputation, personal characteristics, and mode of living, whichever are applicable, may be made, and such disclosure ( A ) is made in a writing mailed, or otherwise delivered, to the consumer, not later than three days after the date on which the report was first requested. I request proof of this alleged item, specifically the application or instrument, with my signature with Credit Management LP.,. If unable to provide the documents requested this account should be deleted from my credit report as soon as possible.
